env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^7 8 9 10 11 12 13 14$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
go build ./...
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build -o $WORK/upstream$GOEXE .
exec $WORK/upstream$GOEXE
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
cd ..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/unionassert

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

type Num interface{ int | string }

type box struct{ v any }

func (b box) get() any {
	return b.v
}

func pick(v any) any {
	return v
}

func main() {
	x := any(7)
	var a Num = x.(Num)
	var b Num = pick(8).(Num)
	bx := box{v: 9}
	var c Num = bx.v.(Num)
	var d Num = any(10).(Num)
	var e Num = box{v: 11}.get().(Num)
	s := []any{12}
	var f Num = s[0].(Num)
	var g Num = (any(13)).(Num)
	var h Num = /* c */ pick( /* d */ 14).( /* e */ Num)
	fmt.Println(a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h)
}
